children: Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - September 9, 2026) - Bold Ventures Inc.
") is pleased to announce that it has received the 2026 'Rising Star Award' at the Central Canada Resource Expo ("
") in Thunder Bay. The award was presented to Bold on the evening of Tuesday, September 8th by CenCan and Mining Life & Exploration News.

The Rising Star Award recognizes and honours a mining company or junior mining company that demonstrates great promise as a future leader and promising producer in Northwestern Ontario. Previous recipients of the award include Kinross Gold Corporation in 2024 and Gold X2 Mining Inc. in 2025.

David Graham, CEO of Bold, stated: "We are excited to have received the Rising Star Award and would like to thank CenCan and Mining Life & Exploration News for this honour. This recognition is a reward for our team's dedication and commitment. We also applaud and congratulate the Ford Government of Ontario for their recognition of the importance of mining to Ontario's economy. We expect that the socio-economic developments resulting from these efforts will be far reaching over the coming decades."

The Company explores for Precious, Battery and Critical Metals in Canada. Bold is exploring properties located in active gold and battery metals camps in the Thunder Bay and Wawa regions of Ontario. Bold also holds significant assets located within and around the emerging multi-metals district dubbed the Ring of Fire region, located in the James Bay Lowlands of Northern Ontario.
